author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The raw query type is narrower than the router query values this serializer preserves.
findings.consequence: Callers that start from vue-router query data need an avoidable cast at the route boundary, and tests exercise null-bearing repeated unknown query values that are not represented by TextSearchRouteQuery. This weakens the type boundary around an exported route serializer, although the current runtime behavior preserves those values.
findings.evidence: serializeTextSearchRouteState accepts raw as TextSearchRouteQuery on line 305. TextSearchRouteQuery only permits string, readonly string[], null, or undefined values, while app/pages/sök.vue casts route.query through unknown before parsing and test/unit/text-search.spec.ts expects an unknown array value containing null to round-trip through this serializer.
findings.recommendation: Widen TextSearchRouteQuery and SerializedTextSearchQuery to include readonly (string | null)[] values, or type the serializer against vue-router's LocationQuery-compatible value shape so the boundary matches the actual caller input without an unknown cast.
